English speech test recording: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland (version 3), by Lewis Carroll, read by Peter Yearsley for LibriVox (2007).
Source: https://librivox.org/alices-adventures-in-wonderland-by-lewis-carroll-3/
Audio: https://archive.org/download/alice_wonderland_0711_librivox/alice_01_carroll_128kb.mp3
LibriVox identifies its recordings as public domain in the USA.
Excerpt: chapter 1, 01:00–01:30. Converted to mono 24 kHz PCM WAV; no other changes.

The previous German recording remains in speech-original.ogg and speech.wav: Matthias Ponnier reading Hiero, by Ulrich Schödlbauer, excerpt by Qualoki.
